decisions.reason: Although the online customer portal is distant from the core and has only a website mention, the firm has invested development resources and publicly introduced it, so escalation pressures make a drop unlikely in the coming year.
The product builds on the established offer and won a public packaging award, creating strong sunk-cost and justification pressures that make dropping very unlikely.
As a close extension of the established display line with its own product page, the firm has committed to it and no disappointing results are evident, so it will likely persist.
This small counter display is close to the core, has its own page, and fits the announced retail-display direction, so management will keep it despite no standout results.
The large freestanding display is close to the established offer and publicly presented; absent clear failure, escalation of commitment favors keeping it.
